canonical_name: Pawing Tigger With Pink Nose
description: This pin features TIGGER skipping to the right and looking back over his right shoulder at his own tail., Originally released in the 1990s, this pin was also sold on WDW 2000 cards for the Millennium Celebration. Other than that, the pins are identical, down to the older backstamp which does NOT have the 2000 Hand in Hand logo on the back (pin is too small).
